sourceChecks.note: Luminox's current exact-reference page identifies XS.0307.WO in the 0300 Series and publishes the white 39 mm fiberglass-compound case, supplied white silicone strap, 48 g configured weight, 12 mm thickness, 19 mm lugs, 316L screw-on back, Ronda 515 Swiss quartz, 100 m resistance, protected double-security-gasket crown, hardened mineral glass, time and date, and constant 24/7 illumination for up to 25 years. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The exact-reference authorized Luminox retailer publishes PLN 1,315, 24-hour dispatch, current low stock, 46 mm lug-to-lug, 39 mm diameter, 12 mm thickness, 19 mm lugs, Ronda 515, -10/+20 seconds per month, 100 m, mineral glass, date, and tritium illumination. Its 40 g field conflicts with Luminox's exact 48 g whole-watch value and is rejected for mass only. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The exact-reference official Luminox dealer independently publishes 39 x 12 mm geometry, Ronda 515 quartz, 100 m, hardened mineral, date, a pull crown, 19 mm lugs, original white silicone strap FPX.1901.10Q.K, and a pushpin mount. This closes the normalized push-pull crown and spring-bar interface without inferring them from the supplied strap alone. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

Ronda's official powertech 515 record publishes an instantaneous rate of -10/+20 seconds per month, three hands, date, and the current calibre specification. Luminox independently identifies 515 as installed in exact XS.0307.WO. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
